title: E-FRC-0157: no steering tried closes the baryon gap while the meson walks: steering toward the string's junction...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0157 in the gauge arena: no steering tried closes the baryon gap while the meson walks: steering toward the string's junction spreads the baryon further (15.3), steering away from stretching is lone steering exactly, and line steering holds the baryon as tight as E-FRC-0131 (spread 2.6 against 2.7) but stops the meson (travel 1.8); a middle member with two strings mostly bounces in place.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
